description: This file contains utility functions and classes for managing storage backends, including wiping files/directories, interacting with PostgreSQL, and handling vector stores like Chroma and Qdrant. It also includes a command interface for executing wipe or stats operations across different storage types.

classes.name: Postgres
classes.description: Handles PostgreSQL database operations such as wiping tables and retrieving stats.

classes.name: Simple
classes.description: Handles wiping of node store files.

classes.name: Chroma
classes.description: Handles wiping of Chroma vector store directories.

classes.name: Qdrant
classes.description: Handles operations for Qdrant vector store, including wiping collections and retrieving stats.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Provides a command interface to perform wipe or stats operations on different storage backends.

methods.name: wipe_file
methods.description: Deletes a specified file if it exists.

methods.name: wipe_tree
methods.description: Deletes all files and directories within a specified directory, except for .gitignore.

methods.name: Postgres.wipe
methods.description: Drops specified tables in the PostgreSQL database.

methods.name: Postgres.stats
methods.description: Prints statistics about tables in PostgreSQL.

methods.name: Command.for_each_store
methods.description: Executes a command ('wipe' or 'stats') on all configured storage backends.

methods.name: Command.execute
methods.description: Runs the specified command across all storage backends.
